experiment.name: robotwin-ztev2-fixed-anchor-pair-20260914
experiment.purpose: Matched ten-task Base/ZeVA continuation from the same completed RoboTwin PI0.5 Base checkpoint
experiment.causal_interpretation_caveat: The shared 4500-step origin and new matched budget make this a controlled development comparison, not a pure single-factor comparison with the earlier experiment.

baseline.zeva_adapter: not instantiated as a trainable branch

zeva.teacher: immutable Base action path loaded from the same 004500 checkpoint
zeva.zeva_adapter: fresh zero-initialized residual projectors; gates initialized at probability 0.01; no old adapter load
zeva.hinge_semantics: relu(student_flow - teacher_flow.detach()) only reweights expert-label flow when the student is worse; it is not teacher-output action distillation and does not guarantee preservation

validation.selection_rule: Compare the pre-fixed step-1000 checkpoints; do not select using formal closed-loop success labels.
validation.post_training_diagnostics: Run the independent eval_robotwin_stage2_diagnostics.py CLI after training; diagnostics do not alter checkpoints.

deployment_protocol.task_language_lookup: inferred task language plus true recurrent H15 phase; no episode_index oracle

runtime.runtime_environment: verified native Transformers overlay, shared H100 dependencies, compiled dependencies, system site order
runtime.launcher: direct accelerate multi_gpu launch; do not call train_robotwin_stage2_8gpu.sh because it mutates runtime symlinks
runtime.compile_cache: one directory per branch under the run root on /mnt/100T
runtime.port_policy: independent explicit DDP port per branch
runtime.gpu_policy: exactly four explicitly listed idle GPUs

caveats: This is a bounded 1000-step development experiment, not a claim that 1000 steps is sufficient for final delivery.
The fixed teacher protects only through the described flow hinge; it is not action-output distillation.
Offline H15/H50 flow is a validation diagnostic, not a substitute for paired RoboTwin success rate.
The success-rate comparison must use matched seeds/instructions and the unchanged H50-output/H15-execution protocol.
